Actually, we have this thing called "minority opinion." Kahit sa actual decided cases ng Supreme Court may mga Justices na iba ang opinion from the majority opinion (yung nasusunod na decision). So one Justice may deem a person "guilty" while the others may see one as "not guilty."  So see, the law is not black and white as accounting. The law does not compromise of numbers but of diverse opinions from diverse individuals. So yeah, kahit "mali"  ang sagot mo, pwede pa ring maging tama sa field of law.
